provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_315: H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] with a = 1 + x^126 + x^138 + x^143 and b = x^164 + x^188 + x^206 + x^268; gcd(a, b, x^315 - 1) has degree 13 (x + 1 times an irreducible factor of degree 12), so k = 26 by design. Every check has weight 8.

search_budget.tool: gf2poly + surrogate (gf2_fast) from the research kit, on Brev n2d-highcpu-64
